newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends down against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends down against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed down on a technical correction at 8.2925 against the U.S. dollar on Wednesday, from a two-year high of 8.2913 on Tuesday, traders said.
The weighted average price on Tuesday was 8.2916.

The yuan opened lower at 8.2916 and consolidated to move around the 8.2920 level for most of the session, hitting an intraday low of 8.2928 and a high of 8.2872. Trading was active with most business done at 8.2920, traders said.
One dealer said a technical correction on Wednesday had been expected after the yuan hit a two-year high on Tuesday.
"The yuan was strong early in trading, but profit-taking set in quickly and pushed it below the 8.2920 level," he said.
A second dealer said the yuan's failure to stand firmly above the 8.2920 level in the past few weeks, which may make it move around the current level in the next few days.
But he said he expected the yuan to close up slightly on Thursday.
The yuan closed up slightly at 7.1150 from 7.1438 against 100 Japanese yen and up at an intraday high of 1.0705 from 1.0718 against the Hong Kong dollar.
